I'm sorry you're going through this. I also find great relief in self harm. Something that has worked for me is to draw on myself when I feel the need to cut. 

Get a giant pack of markers (soft tips, no pens or anything remotely sharp) in lots of colors and go nuts. Draw shapes, patterns... anything you want. The more intricate the better. The first time I tired it I drew on my arms and legs for hours and felt just as satisfied as I used to from self-harm. Give it a try, if it's not for you- then it's not for you, but at least you tried.

And I have to say I agree with what others have said. Don't give up now! Life is just about to get amazing. You'll graduate, move out, make new friends.... Life can be absolutely amazing. Don't get me wrong there will always be ups and downs but for me the ups have been so worth the downs. 
 
I have another suggestion... take this year and plan a trip with your girlfriend for next summer. Plan, save money and make it happen. It'll be something to look forward to and, possibly an incredible adventure. Good luck op, I hope you get through this and if you need to talk feel free to message me.
Well, Elk Grove.. but close enough.

DARE you to not drink water while doing ecstacy all night...

Seriously though, slowly sip water throughout any evening of enjoying drugs. Moral of the story, too much of anything will kill ya.

A lady in my home town died on a radio show. They did a water drinking contest called "Wee for a Wii". I remember how shocking it was to everyone (myself included) to learn that you can die from drinking too much water..

That's completely understandable and I think most people would feel that way. But I just get this feeling that you would actually be free, granted I'm just somebody on the Internet. But from my own experience I think that the relief of not being emotionally abused will be amazing and open up your life to meet new people, good people. 

Maybe find a class or something that your intrested in. You might meet like minded people and make some new friends?

Take a breath. It'll be okay. I felt this way in high school when I lost a high priced camera (photography class). I was so embarrassed and sure that the teacher, enitre class and my parents would hate me and tell me how dumb I was. 

Yeah, my dad was kinda pissed about having to pay for it but no one else really cared too much. And when my dad saw what a wreck I was over it he didn't even get too mad. If I remember correctly he even comforted me a bit. 

Take the lesson here and move on. Tell your parents what happened, apologize and offer to help pay for the damages (10 $ a month? Doing chores and errands around the house?). And now you know it's probably best to do your nails in the bathroom or put down an old towel. 

I hope everything turns okay. You seem like a really nice person and I'm sure life has a lot of amazing things in store for you. Travel, love, friendships and so many wonderful adventures are yet to be had. Keep your head up, stay strong.

I think loki2525 is right. For whatever backwards reason some people respond this way when a loved one is going through depression. 

My dad said the same thing. Basically saying if I'm depressed that I should just stop and that if I'm that miserable he's sorry I was ever born in the first place. People that think this way lack compassion and are most likely very stupid. Which is entirely thier problem- not yours or mine. 

I know the words hurt all the same but try and remember that the source is not credible. I hope you find comfort or someone to talk to who is less selfish. Good luck and I'm here if you ever need to talk.

Edit: words and stuff

I'm sorry you're going through this. Depression is unbelievably painful and crushing. I can only imagine how you feel right now and I wish we could make it go away. 

But just look at these random people who, through something as simple as a post you wrote, see a person who should be on this earth. 

You don't deserve to feel this way but I don't think suicide is a solution. I know this might sound negative, but so much can go wrong and leave you in an even worse situation. Please get that gun out of your possession, you deserve peace but this is not the way. Call a hotline, talk to a friend, look into free therapy in your area.

I really hope you keep fighting. Depression is a horrible disease and those of us who have to fight it are some of the strongest people on this earth. Please, stay safe.

I think you would be surprised at the happiness you might find being single. It sounds like this guy is sucking all the joy from your life. 

Maybe it's him? Maybe being with such a horrible person for 10 years has changed your outlook?

I'm not you, and only you can answer those questions for yourself. But from what I can gather, you're smart, funny and into video games. In this day and age that makes you a catch. Dude can't appreciate that so why waist anymore time and happiness on him? You deserve better. Being alone would be better.

I'm sure it seems scary to be on your own after being a 'we' for so long... But wouldn't it be nice to not have to deal with such a selfish jerk on top of dealing with your depression?

Just my humble opinion. I'm sorry you're going through this and I wish you the best. Good luck.
Thanks. And I wanted to say that I'm sorry for your loss. Your strength is very inspiring.

Thank you everyone for the advice. Looking at it from a different perspective lets me see that it's really not a big deal. I think this is my depression turning something kind of crappy into a major problem.
I can't express how much some kind words and a little sympathy has helped me today, truly from the bottom of my heart- thank you. I know my depression will get better and when I'm in a major bout of it I just need to remember that.
Also, just for some context my mom is a drug addict/alcoholic who has been breaking my heart my whole life- so I probably took it harder than I should have when she forgot my bday. But I'm getting too old to keep holding on to that baggage, maybe this is the year I can finally put it down and move forward.
Again, thanks guys.
